profile:
COMPANY NAME: Airbnb
INDUSTRY: Travel & Hospitality / Short-term Rentals
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: A global marketplace connecting travelers with hosts for vacation rentals, unique homes, and local experiences.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Travelers seeking alternative accommodations and authentic local experiences; property owners and hosts looking to monetize their spaces.
PRICING MODEL: Transaction-based (marketplace commission)
KEY FEATURES: 
- AI-powered search for homes, experiences, and services
- Global inventory of 9M+ active listings across 220+ countries
- Curated "Experiences" for local immersion
- Instant Book and bespoke payments platform
- Host Guarantee and disaster relief tools
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Authentic community connection, massive global scale (2.5B+ guest arrivals), and a diverse range of unique stays beyond traditional hotels.
TONE & POSITIONING: Consumer-focused, community-oriented, and authentic
